claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows two CV axle shafts with rubber boots.
Photo 0 shows a steering rack assembly leaning against the wall.
Witness could not distinguish whether the finned metal part is a radiator or an AC condenser; no labels visible.
Witness describes only a 'small cylindrical starter-motor-like part'; not confirmed to be a starter, no markings legible.

risks.risk: Vehicle make/model/year compatibility unknown, affecting resale value of each part
risks.proof: Close-up photo or video of any stamped part numbers, casting marks, or seller's confirmation of donor vehicle
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unidentified-fitment scrap/parts stock

risks.risk: Parts not tested for function (axles, steering rack, starter)
risks.proof: Video of starter motor spinning on bench test; steering rack moving freely without binding; axle joints rotating without excessive play or noise

risks.risk: Completeness of assemblies (missing bolts, sensors, hoses, boots)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each part's connection points and fittings

risks.risk: CV boot already shown torn on one side; extent of joint wear/grease loss not visible
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the torn boot and joint, plus a photo of the other axle's boot

risks.risk: Radiator/condenser fin damage or leaks cannot be assessed remotely
risks.proof: Clear photo of fins from multiple angles and a pressure/leak test video or photo of water test

risks.risk: Hidden rust, cracks, or corrosion on unseen sides of parts
risks.proof: Additional photos from other angles, including undersides

risks.risk: Unidentified brake caliper and metal rod seen in photo but not mentioned by seller — possible omission or bundling confusion
risks.proof: Seller confirmation of what is actually included in the sale, with a fresh photo showing all items together
risks.if_unproven: excluded from priced lot until confirmed included

proof_requests: Close-up photos of any part numbers or casting marks on each component
Video of starter motor bench-tested for spin
Photo/video of steering rack moving through full range without binding
Photo of both CV boots and joints, including the torn one up close
Clear photos of radiator/condenser fins from multiple angles, plus a leak/pressure test
Confirmation of exact items included (is the brake caliper and metal rod part of this sale?)
Seller confirmation of donor vehicle make/model/year
response.reason: The witness confirms the item category (assorted used auto parts) even though several seller claims (radiator vs condenser, starter identity) and functional condition remain unverified, so the lot can be priced at worst-case scrap/for-parts value pending proof.
